predictions.coreRecommendation: Blackburn's superior home territorial control and Gudjohnsen's finishing give them the edge, but Wrexham's stubborn low block and set-piece threat make Home Win / Draw the premier risk-adjusted stance.

Contingency Angle: 1:1 stalemate script if Wrexham's compact defensive shape blunts central penetration (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Tight mid-table battle at Ewood Park hinges on aerial duels and box efficiency.

spf.comment: Blackburn's strong home record under Mowbray holds the primary edge, while Wrexham's league-high five draws mandate draw containment.
